scientific_integrity: The theorem uses Böröczky–Makai's general 2026 bound as motivation and Florian's established 1995 lower bound; no claim of independent mathematical assessment or absolute priority.
scientific_limitations: Only centrally symmetric genuine six-sided polygons with every side tangent to the John ellipse; not all hexagons or all centrally symmetric convex bodies. Analytic proof with finite reproducibility checks; historical priority remains provisional.
title: The sharp John-normalized polar-area sum for symmetric tangential hexagons
